build_SequenceGenerator: build a SequenceGenerator with beam search to generate translations from a fairseq model ensemble
run_SequenceGenerator_generate: run the SequenceGenerator generate method to produce beam search translations for a batch of source sentences
create_EnsembleModel: create an EnsembleModel wrapper to forward encoder and decoder outputs across multiple fairseq models
review_SequenceGeneratorWithAlignment: review the SequenceGeneratorWithAlignment class to generate translations with hard or soft source-target alignments
refactor_SequenceGenerator__generate: refactor the SequenceGenerator _generate method to customize beam search decoding with prefix tokens or constraints
